literal_meaning: টগবগ শব্দের অনুকরণে, ফুটন্ত বা উচ্ছ্বসিত অবস্থা
example_sentences_in_english: He is marching forward bubbling with enthusiasm.
The children jumped up to play bubbling with excitement.
note: This idiom uses onomatopoeia to evoke the sound of boiling water, symbolizing inner bubbling energy in Bengali expressive tradition.
